messages:
alex.r: Heads-up — planning a controlled traffic steer from NA edge -> EU edge tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Targeting ~15% to start, then steady 50% at +30m if smoke looks good. Will hand back to NA after 3h. Who's on deploy/watch?
maria_g: I'm available for the first hour, can run smoke checks. Will monitor latency graphs and error rate.
sophie: I'll be on-call for rollbacks and routing QA. If we see >3% 5m error spike we rollback.
jamal: I can own DNS change cutover (short TTL swap + weight change). Confirming we'll use the weighted A/B policy (policy-id: steer-v5).
kevin_t: Can you post exact commands for smoke checks and the rollback steps? I'll keep an eye on infra metrics. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled deployment window at 1765518500 (08:00 UTC tomorrow). Set reminder 10m prior. :calendar:
alex.r: Good Q — smoke checks: 1) quick curl against gateway (from eu test runner) `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://api.redwood-prod.example/v1/health` 2) sample gen latency: `python3 tools/latency_probe.py --model llama-13b --region eu` 3) check token-level errors on /v1/generate dashboard.
maria_g: For the curl, expect HTTP 200 and p50 < 200ms. I'll post any failing samples here.
sophie: Rollback steps (brief): 1) set routing policy to fallback-policy (immediate full NA) 2) revert DNS weights to 100% NA by TTL lift 3) scale down EU routing pool if needed `kubectl scale` command in runbook. If I trigger, I'll ping `@channel`.
jamal: DNS plan: lower TTL to 60s 1h before window, then at start do weighted update via internal console (weights: NA 85 -> NA 85 / EU 15 initial). If rollback: set NA 100 / EU 0. I'll paste command in ops console.
kevin_t: Also verify KV-cache warmup on EU nodes; if cold starts high, we might need a higher initial weight. Suggest 20% if warmup is slow.
alex.r: Noted. We'll start 15% but if KV miss rate > 40% after 10m Maria, move to 5% or pause.
maria_g: I'll watch miss rate. If miss_rate > 40% for 2 consecutive 5m windows, I'll call for pause and post metrics.
sophie: Can someone confirm runbook link and who owns the rollback toggle? I can flip toggle if I’m online, otherwise tag me.
jamal: Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/edge-steer-2026. Rollback toggle is in console -> Routing -> toggles (permission: infra-ops+eng-platform).
deploy-bot: Deploy window: 08:00 UTC tomo. Post-deploy check reminder in 20m after start.
kevin_t: I'll prepare a small alert dashboard: p50/p95 latency, 5m error rate, kv-miss-rate. Will share links 10m before window.
alex.r: Final ask: ping here when you make the weight change and paste the exact console diff (so audit logs clear). We'll also record a short post-rollout note in #eng-platform after the handback. :thumbsup:
maria_g: Roger. I'll post timestamps and initial metrics once we start.
sophie: On-call shift overlaps me 07:30-10:30 UTC so I can execute rollback immediately if needed.
jamal: TTL change scheduled at 07:00 UTC (to 60s). I'll confirm when done.
kevin_t: Dashboard links: latency https://grafana.redwood/d/latency, errors https://grafana.redwood/d/errors, kv https://grafana.redwood/d/kv.
alex.r: Thanks team. See you in thread tomorrow. Keep phones on. :rocket:
